description: Computed risk score for an individual insider, derived from weighted behavioral indicators over a scoring window. Updates continuously as new activity arrives.

Semantius platform-owned user table. Referenced from domain `data_objects` via `data_object_relationships` for assignee / author / approver / creator edges. Not surfaced in domain-level analytics (Signal 1/2 ignore `kind='platform_builtin'`).

Utility-owned network infrastructure (substations, transformers, poles, distribution lines, pipelines): type, location, capacity, age, operational status. Distinct from EAM `industrial_assets` (corporate plant) and HAM (IT).
Customer invoice: aggregates meter_reads, regulatory adjustments (demand charges, time-of-use rates, tariffs), payment terms. Distinct from telco_customer_bills, S2P invoices, and rent_payments.

Legal customer-premise record tied to a utility service territory: contract, billing profile, meter assignment, connection status. Residential, commercial, industrial scopes. Distinct from CRM `customers` (sales context).
Electricity, water, gas, waste consumption recorded per period. Source of ESG Scope 1+2 activity data (feeds ESG `activity_data_records`).

Physical meter device at a customer premise (electric/gas/water): device type, manufacturer, install date, certified accuracy class, commissioning state. Distinct from REAL-EST `utility_meter_readings` (the read) and from the meter as a corporate-buyer concept.

Work request to establish new connection / disconnect / move / modify service (not maintenance): premise, requested date, work type, fulfillment status. Distinct from EAM `eam_work_orders` and FSM customer work orders.
IRS 409A fair-market-value report for an issuer: methodology (income / market / asset / OPM backsolve), per-class FMV, valuation date. Final once approved; superseded by future 409As.
A structured value proposition mapping a capability to a persona outcome and competitive differentiation.

DORA-style or VSM-style measurement per repository or product: lead time for changes, deployment frequency, MTTR, change failure rate, computed over a window. Derived/computed; distinct from raw ci_pipeline_runs.
End-to-end value flow from customer demand to customer-realized value, with lead time, process time, value-add ratio, waste categorization, and SIPOC/customer-journey overlays.
Site-specific application prescription map (shapefile / ISO-XML) authored from yield zones and soil tests; dispatched to machinery.

Actual-vs-plan reconciliation records: account, period, planned amount, actual amount, variance, and root-cause commentary. The operational analytic output of EPM; consumed by org leaders, FP&A, and PA (when variance touches people cost).
Investment opportunity flowing through the deal pipeline (sourced → diligence → IC → term sheet → closed / declined). Domain-prefixed to avoid collision with M&A / IB deal records.
Driver Vehicle Inspection Report (DVIR) record: pre-trip or post-trip, defects identified, photos, driver signature. Defects route to maintenance work orders.
Parts stocked in garages / service bays for immediate vehicle repair use.
GPS-segmented trip record: start/end timestamps, route trace, distance, duration, idle time, jurisdictions (for IFTA), driver. Built from raw telemetry by the platform.

Maintenance or repair work order for a fleet vehicle: triggered by PM schedule, telematics fault, or inspection defect; task lines with labor and parts; assigned mechanic and shop; status lifecycle. Distinct from FSM customer-facing work orders.
Pre-payment approval workflow for vendor-direct payments — distinct from employee-initiated spend_requests.
A certificate of insurance on file for a vessel: insurer, policy number, liability limits, and expiry, required by most slip and storage contracts.
A state, Coast Guard, or documented-vessel registration record verified for a vessel: registration number, jurisdiction, and expiry.
A boat on file at the marina: name, type, length, beam, draft, hull identification, and owning boater.
Vesting cadence for an equity grant: cliff, vest_frequency, total months, single-trigger / double-trigger acceleration logic.
Structured lab result for an animal patient: tests, values, reference ranges, ordering vet, reporting lab (external reference lab or in-house analyzer).
Vaccination record for an animal patient: vaccine type, lot, administered date, expiry, next-due-date driving reminder workflow.

A chatbot or virtual-agent conversation transcript: the turn-by-turn exchange, the resolved intent, any deflection or escalation to a human agent, and the ticket it produced. Backs the Virtual Agent capability.
Linkage to an external video meeting (Zoom / Teams / Webex) for a virtual session; carries join URL and recording reference.
Timestamped record of all visitor state transitions (registration / check-in / badge / check-out / escalations): compliance audit trail.
Physical or digital badge credential issued upon check-in: encodes visitor identity, host assignment, access scope, expiration.
Arrival event: timestamped confirmation at facility entry, credential verification, badge-issuance trigger.
Real-time roster of visitors present on-site, correlated with spaces and emergency zones for emergency response and accountability.
Signed or electronically acknowledged non-disclosure agreement: legal-hold artifact per visit. Distinct from CLM `contracts` (corporate agreements).
Pre-visit registration: visitor arrival intent with expected access duration, host assignment, pre-screening completion. Initiates the visitor lifecycle.
Pre-arrival or arrival-time screening result against external watchlists (sanctions, banned-visitor, threat databases): compliance-hold record.

Voluntary candidate disclosure of protected-class membership (race, ethnicity, gender, veteran status, disability status) per EEOC and OFCCP self-id requirements. Distinct from `eeo_responses` which captures the survey response: this row captures the offer/decline-to-answer decision and audit metadata.

A specific weakness detected on a specific asset, deduplicated across scans and tracked through its own lifecycle from open to closed. The headline noun of the domain: a vulnerability links an asset (mastered in ITAM/CMDB) to a vulnerability definition and carries severity, computed risk, ownership, and current state.

A scoped, point-in-time assessment or remediation campaign over an asset population, grouping vulnerabilities for a posture snapshot, audit window, or program milestone. Carries scope, time window, and an aggregate posture summary.

The catalog of known vulnerabilities (CVE identifiers, vendor advisories, plugin or check metadata, affected products, base CVSS severity, references) that incoming scan findings are matched against and enriched from. A reference catalog, not an operational record.

A governed, time-boxed risk acceptance, deferral, or false-positive designation for vulnerabilities the business chooses not to remediate now. Carries justification, requesting and approving parties, scope, and an expiry that drives re-review. Single-approver sign-off gates activation.

Operational remediation work that resolves one or more vulnerabilities: the owning team, due date, SLA, patch or configuration guidance, and verification status. The security-side workflow record; where fixes are executed through a service desk it hands off to ITSM change or incident records.

A scan job run against an asset population using a scan policy or template, progressing through queued, running, and completed states and emitting the findings that become vulnerabilities. Scope-qualified to avoid collision with discovery_scans (ASM) and other scan entities.
Capacity overflow queue for a course offering; priority order and notify-on-seat-open policy.

A walk-up or onsite check-in record: the visitor, the reason for the visit, queue position, estimated service time, and outcome. Backs the Walk-Up capability. The kiosk is treated as a location attribute, not a separate entity.
Per-distribution waterfall computation: hurdle test, catchup, GP carry, LP returns. References the fund's distribution agreement (European / American / hybrid).

Per-page tracking record across web properties: URL/slug, status (published / draft / retired), last-modified, owner, publish date, review cadence, lifecycle stage. CMS-agnostic counterpart to HCMS `content_entries`.
A personalized web experience or landing page served to named accounts.
Storable, URL-routable page composition assembled from content_components for a DXP-served digital channel.
A rule mapping a resolved account/segment to a personalized web experience or variant.
A person/account-level de-anonymization of a web visitor; PII-bearing and consent-gated.
Event subscription: source_system, event_type, target_recipe, retry_policy, filter_logic.

Email, video, push notification, or SMS sent to a new hire during the journey — pre-boarding nudges, Day-1 schedule, post-Day-1 check-ins, cohort announcements. Carries channel, template, scheduled send time, delivery state, and engagement metrics.
B2B order from chef / restaurant / co-op / food-hub buyer; per-line pricing tier, packing-list reference, net-30 invoicing.
A structured interview with a won or lost buyer, capturing the decision drivers; carries interviewee identity and quotes.

Banking-side fund-transfer instruction: originating account, destination (domestic/international), amount, currency, requested delivery, beneficiary, purpose code, compliance flags (sanctions, threshold reporting), execution status, confirmation number. Distinct from S2P supplier payments.
Ordered or parallel set of work_approval_steps gating a work_item or work_project transition. Backs the APPROVAL-WORKFLOW capability (cross-cutting; this is the WORK-MGMT realization).
Single approval gate on a work_item or work_project, performed by a designated approver. Belongs to a work_approval_chain. Per-step states: pending / approved / rejected / expired.

Trigger-action rule defined per board/project: status change, due date, assignment, form submission as triggers; multi-step actions with conditions, time delays, and external integrations. The user-authored behavior layer on top of the data primitives.
Per-work_item value for a work_custom_field. Junction-style master: tuple (work_item, work_custom_field, value). Monday column_values, Asana custom_field_values, Smartsheet cells.

User-defined field attached to a work_project or workspace, typed (text, number, date, select, etc.). Applies to all work_items in scope. Monday columns / Asana custom fields / ClickUp custom fields / Workfront / Smartsheet column types.
Saved, shareable cross-project dashboard composed of configurable widgets that summarize work progress, workload, and goal status. Backs the cross-project dashboards capability.

Typed dependency between two work_items: predecessor/successor with type (FS finish-to-start, SS start-to-start, FF finish-to-finish, SF start-to-finish). Backs the WORK-DEPS-SCHED capability. Modeled by Asana, Monday, ClickUp, Workfront, Smartsheet.

Right-to-work evidence for a worker: visa, work permit, or equivalent authorization, effective-dated with an expiry the system tracks. Jurisdiction-conditional and access-restricted. Distinct from the US-specific hiring I-9 record.
Submitted instance of a work_form. Carries field values, submitter, timestamp. Converts to a work_item via routing rules. May contain personal content from form fields (requester name/email).
Structured intake form definition: schema (fields, validation), target project, routing rules. Asana Forms, Monday Forms, ClickUp Forms, Workfront Request Queues, Smartsheet Forms.
Contribution link between a work item or project and an okr_objective so that goal progress can roll up from the work that drives it.
Operator-facing step sequence for building/assembling a product variant: sequence, resource requirements, quality checkpoints, safety notes, attached media. References product + production_order.
File or external link attached to a work_item. May reference embedded content or platform-managed storage.
Threaded comment on a work_item. Asana stories / Monday updates / ClickUp comments / Workfront updates / Smartsheet conversations. May include personal or sensitive content.
Junction master between work_items and work_tags. Carries no qualifier of its own; existence asserts the tag is applied.

Atomic primitive in a work-management platform: task / item / card with owner, due date, status, priority, dependencies, subtasks, attachments, and comments. Same shape regardless of platform-specific terminology (task, item, row, card).
Zero-duration gate within a work_project marking a meaningful transition. Distinct from a regular work_item by gate semantics (passed/missed). Asana, Monday, ClickUp, Workfront, Smartsheet all model.
Fieldwork documentation: test procedures executed, evidence gathered, conclusions, sign-off. Keyed to audit_programs and control_tests.
Team-level grouping of related projects for cross-project status roll-up. Distinct from the top-down strategic portfolio mastered in the strategic-portfolio domain.
Reusable work_project blueprint with seeded sections, items, custom fields, and automations. Universal across all 5 flagships; central to enterprise rollout patterns.
Container of work_items, regardless of platform-specific terminology (project, board, sheet, space/list). Has timeline, status, owner, members, dashboards, and embedded views.
Published shift schedule for a department / location / week, derived from labor-demand forecasts and worker-availability constraints. The product of a scheduling-optimization run.
Container within a work_project that groups work_items for board/list views. Asana sections / Monday groups / ClickUp statuses-as-columns / Workfront statuses / Smartsheet parent rows.
A scheduled work block assigned to a worker: start, end, position, location, break plan, premium pay flags. The atomic scheduling unit.
Logged status-change event on a work item or project capturing the prior status, the new status, who changed it, and when.
Configurable status value in a project's or team's status taxonomy, with its category (not started, in progress, done) and display order.
Free-form label attached to work_items for cross-cutting categorization (priority, theme, status). Many-to-many to work_items via work_item_tags.
Reusable work_item blueprint with seeded assignee role, due-date offset, subtasks, and custom field defaults. Used for recurring or templated work creation.

Non-billable time logged against a work item for effort tracking and capacity reporting. Billable worklog with rate, utilization, and invoice stays mastered in the services-billing domain and is consumed, not re-mastered, here.
Per-user, per-period sum of allocated effort on work_items, with capacity ceiling. Backs the WORK-CAPACITY capability. Continuous-numeric, not state-driven. May expose individual workload.
Saved, named, shareable board / list / timeline / calendar view of work items with persisted filters, grouping, and sort. A configuration record, not a per-user UI toggle.
Home, work, and mailing addresses for a worker, effective-dated and typed by purpose, supporting multi-jurisdiction and country-variant formats.

Self-service request raised by an employee or manager to change worker data (personal details, address, job, or org assignment), routed through an approval workflow before it commits to the worker record. The self-service surface's first-class request object.

Fully-loaded cost forecast per period, by org unit / role / location / level. Inputs: headcount × comp band × loading factor (benefits, taxes, equity) × jurisdiction. The bridge to EPM — produced inside SWP from the workforce plan, then handed off to EPM where it's rolled into the consolidated budget. Without this object the SWP↔EPM boundary is fuzzy; with it, SWP masters the workforce-driven cost build and EPM masters the consolidated financial plan that consumes it.

Multi-year strategic plan covering target headcount, skills, location, and cost. The SWP umbrella entity; carries planning horizon (typically 1-5 years), base assumptions (attrition rate, hire ramp, productivity factor), approval state (draft / review / approved / published / reconciled), and pointers to the scenarios and forecasts that compose it.

What-if models layered on top of a base workforce plan. Each scenario carries a type (growth / reduction / restructure / geography_shift / skill_pivot / cost_optimization), the perturbation parameters, and the modeled outcome on headcount, skills, and cost. RIF planning, expansion planning, M&A integration, and reorgs all sit here.

Named cohort definitions used for analysis and intervention: hi-po, flight-risk, top-quartile-performer, early-career, returning-from-leave, regrettable-loss-risk. Drives Talent Mgmt programs (high_potential.identified is the canonical outbound handoff) and HR Service Delivery actions.
Employee survey/feedback on office experience: comfort, amenities, satisfaction. Informs workplace strategy and EX improvements.
Employee request for workspace changes: desk relocation, accommodation needs, floor reassignment. Routed to facilities for approval/execution. Workplace-scoped (vs generic ITSM service_requests).
Experience-API event log row capturing actor-verb-object learning activity inside or outside the LMS.
